target: L3 CI-trust repair: require exact-head review quiescence before independent embedded audit and PR Steward final readiness
invariants: RISK_LANE=L3_RED
IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED=NO until a separate explicit operator L3 execution gate is given
MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO
ACTIVATION_AUTHORIZED=NO
BRANCH_PROTECTION_MUTATION=FORBIDDEN in this packet
PR_1286_PRODUCT_REPAIR=OUT_OF_SCOPE; PR #1286 is a read-only regression fixture only
Expensive or provider-backed independent audit MUST NOT start until exact-head review quiescence is mechanically proven
PR Steward final readiness MUST NOT become READY unless the exact audited head also carries a valid exact-head review-quiescence receipt
Every mandatory automated review producer must have completion evidence bound to the current PR head; UNKNOWN completion fails closed
A new PR head invalidates all prior producer-completion and review-quiescence evidence
Any active unresolved blocking review thread prevents quiescence and prevents model audit

Known reviewer completion may be proven only by configured deterministic evidence such as an exact-head review submission, exact-head completed check run, or explicitly permitted bot reaction temporally bound to the unchanged head
No fixed sleep or quiet-window alone may constitute review completion authority
A bounded polling/settle window may be used only as transport coordination around deterministic completion evidence
No review, thread, audit, check, or status may be silently ignored to obtain READY
A stale prior PR Steward READY must be overwritten by failure when quiescence, audit, or exact-head binding is absent or stale
No automatic merge, auto-merge enablement, thread resolution, review dismissal, reviewer removal, or readiness transition is authorized
The implementation must not create a second merge-readiness authority; review quiescence is a prerequisite fact consumed by embedded audit and PR Steward
Current main movement is non-blocking unless it changes packet paths, workflow authority, branch-protection semantics, or the #1286 race facts materially
One final independent L3 audit is required on the frozen substantive content head using a different family/runtime from the implementer
Proof, audit, and readiness claims must bind the final exact content head

pr.title: fix(governance): gate final audit on review quiescence
pr.body: L3 CI-trust/finality repair. Prevent independent embedded audit and PR Steward READY from outrunning late automated reviews. Adds deterministic exact-head review-quiescence evidence, gates provider-backed audit before invocation, and requires the same exact-head quiescence receipt at PR Steward finality. PR #1286 is a read-only regression fixture only. No branch-protection mutation, merge, activation, review dismissal, thread resolution, or auto-merge authority. One final independent L3 audit on the frozen content head is required before operator merge decision.

requirements: Verify repository is DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp and base branch is main.
Record current main SHA/tree; authoring observation was main=5900c27d3c38b515204bd5dc4baed8b5e14e2a8e and tree=1c7376097b714bbea6ee42cc1c5abeda2e72bb1b.
Re-read current AGENTS.md, governance/rules, docs/ops/pr-steward.md, canonical Task Packet schema, current .github/workflows/embedded-audit.yml, and .github/workflows/pr-steward.yml.
Reharvest current branch protection/rulesets and confirm required finality checks.
STOP before any mutation unless explicit operator L3 implementation authority for this packet is present.
Do not silently change runner, model, network, credentials, mutation scope, or provenance.
validation: current main/tree and branch-protection facts recorded

steps.task: Freeze the late-review race as a deterministic regression case and census review-producer evidence surfaces.
requirements: Use PR #1286 only as read-only evidence; do not repair or mutate it.
Reconfirm exact live PR #1286 head before using the fixture.
Preserve the observed ordering from the accepted evidence: independent embedded audit completed before PR Steward READY, then Copilot and Codex exact-head reviews arrived later.
Record each automated review producer that can create a blocking review/thread after ready_for_review or synchronize.
For each producer, define deterministic completion evidence and fail closed if completion cannot be mechanically observed.
Do not infer completion from elapsed time alone.
validation: every mandatory producer has deterministic completion semantics or is UNKNOWN/blocking

steps.task: Implement a deterministic exact-head review-quiescence evaluator and typed receipt.
requirements: Create tools/pr_steward/review_quiescence.py and schemas/pr_steward/review_quiescence.schema.json.
Create tools/pr_steward/review_producers.json containing only explicitly supported producer identities and completion-evidence strategies.
Quiescence input must bind repository, PR number, exact current head SHA, producer identities, review submissions/check runs/reactions used as evidence, and unresolved-thread state.
A producer completion receipt from an older head is stale and cannot be reused.
A missing or ambiguous mandatory producer completion is UNKNOWN and blocks quiescence.
Any active unresolved blocking review thread yields NEEDS_IMPLEMENTER and blocks quiescence.
The evaluator may poll for bounded transport convergence, but timeout must return BLOCKED/UNKNOWN without invoking any model.
Emit REVIEW_QUIESCENCE.json with verdict QUIESCENT, NEEDS_IMPLEMENTER, BLOCKED, or UNKNOWN and exact evidence references.
The evaluator is read-only against GitHub.
validation: schema validates positive and negative fixtures
elapsed time alone never yields QUIESCENT

steps.task: Gate embedded-audit before provider setup/invocation so premium audit usage occurs only after review quiescence.
requirements: Modify .github/workflows/embedded-audit.yml so review-quiescence evaluation runs before setup/install/invocation of any model auditor.
Preserve trusted-base execution and candidate-as-data containment.
On NOT_QUIESCENT/NEEDS_IMPLEMENTER/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN, do not install or invoke the model auditor; emit/retain fail-closed diagnostic evidence sufficient to keep the required audit gate non-green.
Use concurrency/cancellation so superseded head runs cannot later publish authoritative evidence.
Exact-head change resets quiescence and audit eligibility.
Do not weaken current embedded-audit proof identity enforcement.
Do not remove or bypass the required independent embedded audit check.
validation: #1286 timing fixture proves provider/model invocation count is zero before both mandatory reviewer completions and thread closure
passing quiescence permits exactly one final audit attempt for the frozen head

steps.task: Bind PR Steward READY to the same exact-head review-quiescence receipt and preserve fail-closed finality.
requirements: Modify .github/workflows/pr-steward.yml to select and validate the exact-head REVIEW_QUIESCENCE.json associated with the embedded-audit subject before PR Steward can publish success.
If quiescence receipt is missing, malformed, non-QUIESCENT, wrong-repo, wrong-PR, or wrong-head, publish PR Steward / final readiness=failure.
Update collector/classifier only where required to expose and classify quiescence without creating a second readiness authority.
Prior green READY on the same head must be overwritten by failure when a later authoritative run proves quiescence/audit invalid.
Unknown reviewers or producer evidence remain blocking.
No PR mutation is added.
validation: READY impossible without exact-head QUIESCENT receipt
stale prior READY overwritten on invalid finality
